requirement: the fleet-chat panel offers a screenshot button and Ctrl+P (Cmd+P) capture, and the transcript is selectable and copyable

assertions.shortcut: Ctrl+P/Cmd+P registered in capture phase and prevents the print dialog
assertions.selection: user-select:text on transcript, click-to-reply suppressed while text is selected
assertions.limitation: the relay chat payload is text-only, so an image is not broadcast as a message; it is copied and previewed locally
